card.title: Choose the round-3 retry design after two Sonnet failures
card.body: <!-- sprint-meta risk=R2 spec=2026-09-10-roles-and-souls spec_sha256=deadbeef area=maintenance slug=t_5s6t7u8v -->

args.reason:
DECISION: The round-3 escalation landed here with the same failure twice - is the spec wrong or is round 3 missing context?
Why: two Sonnet rounds hit the identical blocker; Opus 5 is round 3's escalation
Class: R2
1. re-read the spec section and retry the same approach - already tried twice, unlikely to differ
2. ask the lead whether the spec's acceptance line is achievable as written - may reveal a spec bug
Recommend: 2 - two identical failures under Sonnet argue for a spec check, not a third attempt
Learn: if round 3 escalation repeats this pattern, add a spec-ambiguity check before round 2
